open_points.subject: runtime setting validation ownership
open_points.text:
the default of each optional setting, and the refusal of a missing required setting or of a value of the
  wrong form.
open_points.question: Does “wrong form” include every value rejected by A8—an out-of-range integer port, an unknown time zone, and a string outside RuntimeEnvironment—or only values that cannot be parsed into the declared type; and, if only parsing failures are included, which module owns the remaining refusals?
options: runtime_settings refuses every value that A8 does not accept
runtime_settings refuses only type or parsing failures and another start-up module refuses semantic violations
runtime_settings refuses only type or parsing failures, leaving semantic violations without an owner
open_points.default_guess: Treat every value that violates the A8 start-up table, including range, enumeration, and time-zone-database constraints, as being of the wrong form and refuse it in runtime_settings.

witness.initial: PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT is set to "70000", which parses as a whole number but is outside A8's range.
events: The process starts and runtime_settings reads PORTAL_DELIVERER_PORT.
runtime_settings interprets the changed ownership statement.
outcomes: “Wrong form” includes the permitted range, so runtime_settings ends start.
“Wrong form” means only failure to parse an integer, so runtime_settings returns settings containing port 70000 or leaves a later module to reject it.
witness.observer: start-up integration tests and the operator starting the service
